# <strong>Tracking Spending</strong>: Sub-Categories {.unnumbered}

Platforms like Amazon, PayPal, and Instacart can make transactions confusing because they can map to multiple categories (the descriptions alone are ambiguous).

One way to reconcile this is to create a `Sub-Category` column. `Sub-Category` can be formatted as free-text or with a controlled list scoped under the parent `Category` column.
